name: Finnmark FD-1 | 1-Person Full-Spectrum Infrared Sauna
description: Description Imagine a space in your home that’s reserved just for you. A place where you can shut the door on a chaotic day, take a deep breath, and melt into a wave of soothing warmth. That's the dream, right? We think so too. The Finnmark FD-1 Full Spectrum Sauna is a personal retreat designed to deliver a powerful wellness experience without needing a ton of space. It stands out by reaching a true maximum temperature of 170°F, a benchmark many competitors don't meet. What's more, it’s backed by a comprehensive 10-Year Warranty and is ETL and UL Certified for safety and performance. Best of all? It does all this while plugging into a standard home outlet— no electrician required . With a design trusted by over 15,000 users, this isn't just a sauna; it's an investment in a daily ritual for your well-being. Finnmark vs. Others Features When you start looking at saunas, the technical jargon can feel a little overwhelming. Let's break down what really matters and how it makes your experience better. No Electrician Needed: Plugs Into a Standard Outlet. Forget about the cost and hassle of hiring an electrician. This sauna is engineered for efficiency, running perfectly on a dedicated standard 120v home outlet. It makes setup incredibly simple. Advanced Dual-Wave Heating: The FD-1 pairs powerful, UL-listed Spectrum Plus™ heaters (for deep penetration) with Spectrum Carbon 360° panels (for full-body immersion) for an experience that's both intense and comforting. Think of it like feeling the sun's deep warmth on your skin, combined with a gentle heat that wraps all around you. High Emissivity & Low EMF: Its heaters are not only powerful but also highly efficient at radiating infrared heat. They've also been rigorously tested to ensure ultra-low EMF levels, so you can relax with total peace of mind. Antimicrobial Canadian Cedar Interior: You want your wellness space to be, well, clean. Finnmark uses beautiful Western Canadian Cedar because it naturally resists mold and bacteria. It smells amazing and keeps this sanctuary fresh session after session. Smart, Insulated Construction: The sauna features high-quality, double-walled construction packed with non-toxic wool insulation. This means it heats up faster, holds its temperature steady, and is more energy-efficient. What's Included No surprise trips to the hardware store. Here’s everything that arrives at your door, ready for you to build your personal oasis. Sauna Wall, Floor & Ceiling Panels Pre-Hung 8mm Tempered Glass Door Ergonomic Backrest & Sauna Bench All Infrared Heater Panels & Red Light Therapy Units Built-in LCD Touchscreen Controller 2.0 Bluetooth Audio with 6" HiFi Speakers All Cables, Screws, and Power Supply Unit Removable & Adjustable Feet (for uneven floors) Comprehensive 10-Year Warranty & ETL Certification Specifications Model FD-1 External Materials Thermo-Aspen Interior Materials Western Canadian Cedar Volts 120 Watts 1750 Amperage 15 Phase Single Plug Type NEMA 5-15P Outlet Standard 120v 15a Maximum Temperature 170F Interior Dimensions 32"W x 34"D x 70"H Exterior Dimensions 38"W x 38"D x 78"H Room Volume 44.1 cu. ft. Door Dimensions 23.625"W x 67.875"H Door Handle Dimensions 1.875"W x 11.625"H Glass Thickness 8mm Product Weight 301 lbs Shipping Dimensions 36"W x 78"D Shipping Weight 349 lbs w/48 lb Pallet Assembly, Cost & Documents Worried about setup and your utility bill? Don't be. Finnmark made it incredibly simple. Assembly: Think of it like building with grown-up LEGOs. The panels latch together easily. Grab a friend (it's a two-person job to be safe) and a screwdriver for the door handle. You’ll have it set up in about 60-90 minutes. Operating Cost: Because it's so efficient, running this sauna is surprisingly affordable. Based on the average US electricity rate, a full one-hour session typically costs around 20 to 30 cents. It’s a little luxury that won’t give you a shock when the power bill arrives. Owner's Manual
